objective: Consume verified feedback for one synthetic pharmacy task and leave a reviewable outcome or an accountable next decision.
nonGoals: Autonomous approval, merge, deployment, policy changes or credential access

intake.trigger: Explicit manual invocation; scheduled maintainer reporting remains a separate workflow.
intake.revisionRule: Bind evidence to the application revision; a workflow-only revision does not create new work.
intake.eligibleTask: One owned maintenance recommendation or exact failed-check receipt.

roles.worker: GitHub Copilot is the primary worker; optional harnesses retain their own capability boundaries.
roles.verifier: Deterministic checks run outside the worker's authorized edit scope.
roles.owner: Workshop maintainer or configured station owner
roles.releaseOwner: Explicit human release authority, separate from this loop

verification.failureRule: Only specific trusted task failure authorizes repair; missing evidence and setup failures are blocked, not no-op.

persistence.local: Owned station-local JSON state with explicit profile and work identity
persistence.github: An owned, marked issue or comment; no implicit downstream workflow trigger
rules: Persist attempt reservation before worker execution.
Read previous state in every fresh invocation.
Reconcile publication references before retrying interrupted work.
Reject mismatched identity or unsupported versions.
Reset only explicitly owned task state; retain unrelated learner work.

limits.inferencePolicy: Existing workflow-specific worker and detector credit caps remain separate; local replay spends no inference.

enforcement.controller: Identity, evidence, attempt accounting and next-decision validation
enforcement.adapter: Owned persistence, configured serialization and side-effect reconciliation
enforcement.github: Least-privilege tools, safe outputs, deterministic checks and explicit human controls
enforcement.sandboxLimitation: Local JSON and human approval fixtures model decisions; they are not live GitHub controls or a security sandbox.
